ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: In the figure is a transition state/reaction structure; on the left there is a central carbon, connected to two phenyl groups labeled Ph, and connected to an O; this O is further connected to SiPh3. On the right there is also an H–OH (water/hydroxyl-related component), and there are curved arrows, but the question requires ignoring the arrows and excluding bonds involving hydrogen. Reasoning count: Decomposing by substituent blocks, there are five phenyl groups in the figure: the two Ph on the central carbon, plus the three Ph on SiPh3. Each benzene ring internally is counted as 6 non-hydrogen bonds, so the number of internal bonds in the benzene rings is 5 × 6 = 30. Exocyclic non-hydrogen connecting bonds include: two central C–Ph bonds = 2, three Si–Ph bonds = 3, one central C–O bond = 1, one O–Si bond = 1. The O–H bonds in the H–OH/water component all involve hydrogen and are excluded; the arrows are also not counted. Total = 30 + 2 + 3 + 1 + 1 = 37.

raw_record.question_text:
In the transition-state structure shown in the image, calculate the total number of bonds in the structure, including single, double, and triple bonds but excluding those involving hydrogen.

Note: Disregard arrows. Consider all components present in the transition-state structure shown in the image.

method.method_draft: Decompose the image into substituent blocks. Count the internal bonds of the five phenyl rings as 5 × 6 = 30. Count the non-hydrogen attachment/linker bonds outside the rings: central C–Ph twice = 2, Si–Ph three times = 3, central C–O = 1, and O–Si = 1. Exclude both O–H bonds in the H–OH/water component and ignore arrows. Sum 30 + 2 + 3 + 1 + 1 = 37.
method.CoT_raw:
图像描述：图中是一个过渡态/反应结构，左侧有一个中心碳，连着两个标为 Ph 的苯基，并连着一个 O；该 O 再连到 SiPh3。右侧还有一个 H–OH（水/氢氧相关组分），并有弯箭头，但题目要求忽略箭头、排除涉及氢的键。
推理计数：按取代基块分解，图中共有五个苯基：中心碳上的两个 Ph，加上 SiPh3 上的三个 Ph。每个苯环内部按 6 条非氢键计数，所以苯环内部键数为 5 × 6 = 30。环外非氢连接键包括：中心 C–Ph 两条 = 2，Si–Ph 三条 = 3，中心 C–O 一条 = 1，O–Si 一条 = 1。H–OH/水组分中的 O–H 键都涉及氢，排除；箭头也不计。总数 = 30 + 2 + 3 + 1 + 1 = 37。
